message:
feat(seo): IndexNow push for changed items

Google Search Console's 'Request indexing' has a daily quota of roughly ten
URLs, which cannot cover 660 pages — that is what the 'quota exceeded'
dialog was. IndexNow is the quota-free alternative: changed URLs are pushed
straight to the participating engines.

- scripts/indexnow.cjs posts the changed item URLs (page, RU page and widget)
- scripts/generate-indexnow-key.cjs publishes the key at the site root, which
  IndexNow requires for verification
- scripts/changed-items.cjs works out which items moved by comparing against
  git; a plain git diff cannot do this, because with unified=0 the unchanged
  'id' lines never appear, so it reported zero changed items every time
- the nightly workflow now pushes the changed URLs after every price update
author: BSS Index Developer
